images.desc: List of full paths to the Nifti images representing the statistical maps.

images_meta.desc: Dictionaries containing metadata for each image.

vocabulary.desc: An array of strings retrieved from neurosynth.org. Only returned if ``fetch_neurosynth_words`` and ``vectorize_words`` were set.

word_frequencies.desc: For each image, the weights of the words from 'vocabulary such that the weight of word ``vocabulary[j]`` for the image found in ``images[i]`` is ``word_frequencies[i, j]``. Only returned if ``fetch_neurosynth_words`` and ``vectorize_words`` were set.
